title: Frontend: Pagination
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Pagination. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({items=[Alpha,Beta,Gamma,Delta,Epsilon],pageSize=2}). Search input filters case-insensitive substrings and resets to first page. Sort button toggles ascending/descending ASCII order and resets page. Next/Previous clamp. Render li names and [data-testid=page] current/total, 0/0 when empty. Apply filter, sort, then slice.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Choose offset or cursor semantics before building controls.
alternativeApproaches: Compare offset and keyset pagination under concurrent inserts using a stable unique tie-breaker.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Filter shrinks pages; request race; zero results.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
